title: THOUGH I WALK IN TROUBLE
PSALM 138:7 MIDNIGHT PRAYER
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: If trouble surrounds you in this dark hour, God sees your distress right now.
Scripture declares: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me:
thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
scenes.sub: THY RIGHT HAND SHALL SAVE ME

scenes.a: Lord, when trial presses close on every side, breathe your quiet strength into our weary heart.
Reach out your victorious right hand and deliver us from every lingering threat that haunts the shadows.
Revive our spirit in this midnight watch and grant us deep, abiding peace tonight. Amen. Subscribe to stand with The Midnight Watch in prayer.
